title: Monthly Refresher Training Webinar June 11, 2015
description: Join our Monthly Refresher Training Webinar held on June 11, 2015, focusing on Website Compliance Information Resources. Learn about managing your Healthcare Compliance Pros program, OSHA and HIPAA Assessments, and Training Reminders. Participants received a free Blank Module for custom training.
body:
Webinar Recording Link: Website Compliance Information Resources

Our Monthly Refresher Training Webinars have focused on a variety of topics including: a general overview of managing your Healthcare Compliance Pros program, OSHA and HIPAA Assessments, managing Training Reminders, etc. The Monthly Refresher Training for June covered Website Compliance Information Resources and all participants received a free Blank Module. The Blank Modules can be used to develop and track organization specific training.
